claims.statement: For every genuine Boolean f on disjoint uniform cubes with X-degree at most d, if each positive normalized X-Fourier row is a constant or an affine-subspace-coset defect on the physical Y cube, then H(S_Y|S_X)<=4 I_Y(f). Hence H(f)<=(4+2/ln2)I_Y(f)+2(d-1)-E Gamma_d(f_y). The condition excludes repeated arbitrary positive-entropy tensor cores without assuming FEI.
claims.quantifiers: All finite disjoint uniform Boolean cubes X,Y; every genuine Boolean f; integer d>=1; every positive X-spectral row satisfying the displayed constant-magnitude affine-code condition.
uses: B07-A034-ANCHORED-TAIL-v1 for the k-bit defect entropy estimate
scope_exclusions: Generic rows need not have constant magnitude
